answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the prism is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the raven of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
